title: Same Tree
summary: Check whether two binary trees have the same shape and the same values at every position.

tests.explain: Same shape and same value at every position.
Both trees hold 1 and 2, but 2 is the left child in one and the right child in the other: different shapes.
The shapes match but the values at the two child positions are swapped.

hints: Two trees are the same when their roots match and their left subtrees match and their right subtrees match. That is a recursive definition: use it directly.
Handle the empty cases first. Both null means these two positions agree. Exactly one null means the shapes differ.
If either node is null, return p === q. Otherwise return p.val === q.val && isSameTree(p.left, q.left) && isSameTree(p.right, q.right).

complexity.time: O(min(n, m)): you stop at the first mismatch, and never go beyond the smaller tree
complexity.space: O(h) for the recursion, where h is the smaller tree's height
